A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are trying to understand how to best balance the needs of agriculture with the needs of biodiversity and climate regulation.
we are trying to understand how the different ecosystem services are distributed across the landscape and how that distribution can be optimized for multiple ecosystem services.
we have developed a framework to help reconcile multiple environmental goals when the services they provide vary across the landscape and across scales.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the tradeoffs between multiple ecosystem services are complex and vary regionally.
the tradeoffs among ecosystem services are not fixed, but depend on the spatial distribution of the services and on the goals and priorities of decision-makers.
tradeoffs between ecosystem services are inevitable, but they can be minimized by considering the regional distribution of the services in question.
